text:
jia: quick review: prototype for Snapshot details modal posted https://www.figma.com/file/NEW. Need to lock focus target and copy variants before handoff. two quick q's: heading vs first action focus? and how to avoid timeline SR double-announce?
omar: heading first + role="dialog". users get context immediately. add aria-describedby to short summary.
petra: timeline is currently aria-live="polite" and fires on snapshot create. simplest is to set aria-hidden on timeline while modal open (use inert polyfill). fallback: set tabindex=-1 on focusables.
maria: agree. also prefer CTA shorter copy on small screens: "Rewind" (aria-label="Rewind to snapshot v5"). add a tiny pulse class on the triggering pill for 500ms on close so keyboard users see origin. respect prefers-reduced-motion.
jia: dev snippet for focus restore to include fallback if virtualized item recycled: `const lastFocused = document.activeElement; openModal(); closeModal(); setTimeout(()=>{(lastFocused && document.contains(lastFocused)) ? lastFocused.focus() : document.querySelector('[data-snapshot-trigger]')?.focus()}, 60);`
omar: include aria-live span scoped to canary percent with aria-atomic="true" so updates announce without re-reading whole modal.
petra: test matrix: VoiceOver + NVDA for open/close read behaviour. file bug if any double reads. a11y-bot: create checklist item.
a11y-bot: Created A11Y-8122: Snapshot modal focus + background inertness + live-region scoping (assignees: omar, petra).
jia: i'll update Figma with heading copy "Snapshot details — v5", add copy-state table, and the dev notes. ping when ready for final pass. :white_check_mark:
